title: DC-area forecast: Hottest day of the week with late day-storm potential
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: It's the hottest day of the week. Temperatures climb into the low to mid-90s this afternoon. Storms are possible late afternoon into evening, particularly between 3 and 7 p.m., and perhaps strongest and most numerous from near DC to the north.

What’s next? Shower and thunderstorm chances continue Tuesday and Wednesday while it remains hot and muggy. Temperatures and humidity ease by late week or the weekend.

Today’s daily digit — 3/10: With a chance to hit 95 degrees and storms possible, too, I wouldn't mind taking a pass on today's weather. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Monday): Plenty of sunshine should push highs into the low to mid-90s with light winds from the south. Factoring in the humidity (dew points near 70), it'll feel closer to 100 this afternoon. There is a decent chance some storms come through from west to east, roughly between 3 and 7 p.m., although probably only lasting an hour or less for any given location. Storm odds are a little higher from near DC to the north than to the south of DC. Some storms could be severe. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: A few showers and storms remain possible during the evening and overnight, especially from DC north. Otherwise, expect a mostly cloudy and muggy summer night, with a chance of lingering showers and storms overnight. Lows range from around 70 in the cooler suburbs to the mid-70s downtown. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Tuesday): Variably cloudy, very warm and humid, with dew points in the low 70s and highs around 90. Showers and thunderstorms are possible again, and a few could become strong to severe. While storms are most likely during the evening, a few could develop earlier in the day. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Scattered showers and thunderstorms remain possible. Otherwise, skies are mostly cloudy with muggy lows from 70 to 75. Confidence: Medium

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Wednesday and Thursday look fairly similar, with partly sunny skies, continued moderate to high humidity and highs near 90. Each day brings a small chance of late afternoon and evening showers and thunderstorms, but lower chances than early in the week. Nights remain muggy, with lows generally between 70 and 75. Confidence: Medium

Friday could turn less hot and humid with lower storm chances, if a cold front moves far enough to our south. For now highs are anywhere from the 80s to near 90. Confidence: Low

The weekend should be somewhat less hot and humid as dew points fall into the 60s. Highs should mainly reach the mid-80s, with overnight lows in the mid-60s to near 70. Skies are generally partly sunny, with only a slight chance of an afternoon or evening shower or thunderstorm each day. Confidence: Low-Medium

DC weather history for August 10

A tragic 1943 lightning strike at Fort Belvoir killed six soldiers instantly, marking the deadliest lightning incident on record in the DC area.
